items.title: Ife Museum Renovation
items.description: Restoring the town's museum wing to properly display and protect its terracotta and bronze collection.

items.title: Oduduwa Grove Access Road
items.description: Rehabilitating the road connecting the town center to the Grove to support both residents and visitors.

items.title: Ward Borehole Program (Phase 1)
items.description: Clean water access delivered to five wards previously reliant on unsafe sources.

items.title: Youth Skills Center
items.description: A permanent training facility now hosting the Board's vocational and digital-skills programs.

items.title: Palace Heritage Trail
items.description: A walkable, signposted route connecting Ife's major sacred and historical sites for visitors and students.

items.title: Healthcare
items.description: Expanding access to primary healthcare facilities across Ife's wards, pending funding.
